pages.title: Build an automatic door
pages.text: Place Door Markers across the floor of an opening. Put a ceiling above them to stop panels at the intended height; a marker normally fills up to six blocks above itself. Its facing is perpendicular to the opening’s width.$(br2)Unlocked doors open for nearby players and soldiers. The hologram’s icon buttons choose the symbol displayed on the door panels. Nearby Locks control access.

pages.title: Control nearby doors
pages.text: A Lock controls Door Markers, Storage Cubes and Holo Storage Cubes within its configured horizontal and vertical range. A matching Key Card toggles the lock and its targets.$(br2)Unlock the controller before adjusting its range sliders. Keep control areas separate so two Locks do not compete over one door or storage cube.$(br2)For a player-built switch-controlled entrance, use a Wireless Lock and Wireless Button.
